def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; fg=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==fg]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); r1=max(i for i,j in pts)
    c0=min(j for i,j in pts); c1=max(j for i,j in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # four border segments
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):   # top row
        if out[r0][j]==bg: out[r0][j]=2
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):   # bottom row
        if out[r1][j]==bg: out[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):   # left col
        if out[i][c0]==bg: out[i][c0]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):   # right col
        if out[i][c1]==bg: out[i][c1]=2
    return out
